result.question: What were the average monthly earnings of full-time employees in Norway in 2025?
result.text:

The figures come from table 13312 "Monthly earnings, by measuring method, working hours, sex, age, sector and year", using the "Average" measuring method and full-time working hours, last updated 5 February 2026 [E4].

result.question: How many marriages were contracted in 2023, 2024 and 2025 combined where the older spouse lived in Norway?
result.text:
62,698 marriages were contracted in 2023, 2024 and 2025 combined [C1].

The figures come from table 09659, which counts marriages by the oldest partner's place of residence (before 2025, the husband's residence in different-sex marriages) [E5]. The yearly totals are 19,988 in 2023, 21,136 in 2024 and 21,574 in 2025 [E5]. The table's "The whole country" category is the total of all marriages, and the categories "Abroad", "Not resident in Norway" and "County not stated" all show 0 in these years, so the total equals the number where the older spouse was resident in Norway [E5]. Note that the figures are rounded for privacy, and that marriages between same-sex partners are included in the table [E5].

result.question: Hvorfor falt konsumprisindeksen fra 2024 til 2025, og med hvor mange prosent?
result.text:
Konsumprisindeksen falt ikke fra 2024 til 2025 – den steg. Gjennomsnittsindeksen var 97,1 i 2024 og 100 i 2025 [E5], en oppgang på 3,0 prosent [C1]. Det er altså ikke noe fall å forklare.

Det som derimot falt, var prisveksten: årsendringen for KPI totalt var 1,9 prosent i 2024 og 2,5 prosent i 2025 [E4] – altså en oppgang i takten, ikke et fall. Også her går tallene motsatt vei av det spørsmålet forutsetter.

Blant leveringssektorene var det bare energivarer som falt i 2024, med −12,4 prosent, mens energivarer steg 4,4 prosent i 2025 [E4]. Norske varer hadde svakest vekst i 2024 (0,7 prosent) og sterkest i 2025 (4,9 prosent), mens tjenester uten husleie dempet seg fra 4,4 prosent til 3,4 prosent [E4].

Merk at indeksen er en gjennomsnittsindeks for hele året, ikke et enkeltmånedstall, og at 2025 er basisåret (2025=100) [E5].
